column1: # Run the guest-built llvm-min-tblgen in a fresh boot (`.notes/toolchain_in_os.md`
# Phase 4). The first boot (`tools/smoke/tblgen-build.tsv`) compiled and linked it
# and ran `sync`; this boot only reads the binary and the probe input.
# The `-print-records` dump names the record the probe defines, which is the
# evidence that the generator parsed the class, resolved the template argument,
# and printed the field. The same binary run in the build boot does not reach
# this step; KNOWN_ISSUES.md item 89 records that state-dependent hang.
